title: EndoVLA-OOV: Language-Conditioned Out-of-View Target Acquisition in Robotic Endoscopy
summary: The scan-then-revisit workflow of upper gastrointestinal endoscopy requires bringing a previously observed suspicious region back into view for closer inspection. Acquiring such targets requires translating anatomical and appearance descriptions into camera motions from partial observations of a confined, deformable environment. We present EndoVLA-OOV, a language-conditioned vision-language-action policy for out-of-view target acquisition in robotic endoscopy. The policy adapts a pretrained backbone to continuous two-degree-of-freedom distal bending commands and combines initial, intermediate, and current images to guide search. To support policy learning, we provide an open-source VLA dataset containing 1,050 episodes across six tasks and approximately 262k observation-action pairs. Physical evaluation spans wet-lens and low-light conditions, two unseen stomach phantoms, and cross-embodiment transfer to an unseen ex-vivo environment. In the cross-embodiment evaluation, the full-data policy achieves 93.3% target acquisition success (28/30). In a controlled training-data comparison, expanding the corpus from 312 to 1,050 episodes increases acquisition success from 40.0% to 90.0% under the same model, training, and test configuration. Instruction and observation interventions further support the use of language and temporal context in the evaluated acquisition tasks. These results support language-guided endoscopic revisitation across the evaluated environments and robot embodiments and demonstrate the benefit of expanded task-specific demonstrations.
tldr: Presents EndoVLA-OOV, a language-conditioned vision-language-action policy that maps endoscopic images and language descriptions to 2-DOF distal bending commands for reacquiring out-of-view targets in robotic endoscopy. It contributes an open-source dataset of 1,050 episodes and physical evaluations showing 93.3% cross-embodiment acquisition success, with clear gains from more demonstrations.
tldr_zh: 提出EndoVLA-OOV，一种语言条件下的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，将内镜图像与语言描述映射为两自由度远端弯曲命令，用于在机器人内镜中重新获取视野外目标。论文提供了包含1050个episode的开源数据集，物理实验显示跨平台目标获取成功率达93.3%，且更多演示数据显著提升性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：上消化道内窥镜检查的“先扫描后重访”工作流程要求将先前观察到的可疑区域重新移入视野进行更仔细的检查。获取此类目标需要将解剖学和外观描述转换为对受限、可变形环境的局部观察下的相机运动。我们提出了EndoVLA-OOV，一种用于机器人内窥镜中视野外目标获取的语言条件视觉-语言-动作策略。该策略将预训练主干网络适配为连续的二自由度远端弯曲指令，并整合初始、中间和当前图像来引导搜索。为支持策略学习，我们提供了一个开源VLA数据集，包含六个任务中的1,050个片段和约262k个观察-动作对。物理评估涵盖湿镜和低光条件、两个未见过的胃部模型，以及向未见过离体环境的跨实体迁移。在跨实体评估中，全数据策略实现了93.3%的目标获取成功率（28/30）。在受控训练数据对比中，在相同模型、训练和测试配置下，将语料库从312个片段扩展到1,050个片段使获取成功率从40.0%提升至90.0%。指令和观察干预进一步支持了在所评估的获取任务中对语言和时间上下文的使用。这些结果支持在所评估的环境和机器人实体中进行语言引导的内窥镜重访，并展示了扩展任务特定演示的益处。

title: CROPS: Cosserat-Rod-Based Co-Design of Soft Slender Programmable Material Systems for Biomedical Applications
summary: Slender structures made of stimuli-responsive materials represent an emerging class of programmable material systems, with applications in soft robotics, minimally invasive surgery, wearable electronics, and deployable structures. In biomedical applications, the on-demand design of slender structures, encompassing both their material layout and actuation, is essential to harnessing their large deformation and multiphysics actuation to meet patient-specific design requirements. However, owing to geometric and material nonlinearities, their structure-actuation-response relationship is highly nonintuitive and computationally demanding. This often makes trial-and-error and conventional design approaches challenging for addressing patient-specific needs. To this end, we present a Cosserat-rod-based design optimization framework for the autonomous design of programmable slender structures. Leveraging the Cosserat rod representation, the end-to-end differentiable framework is demonstrated on two case studies: (i) design of swellable stents that morph to the shape of carotid vessels; (ii) co-design of the remnant magnetization and the applied field of magnetically-active catheters to reduce the force exerted on the patient-specific vessel wall during insertion. Both self-contact and external contact with surrounding structures are accounted for. We consider two actuation mechanism, namely the swelling of gel-elastomer composites and the magnetic actuation of hard-magnetic composites. The proposed framework presents an autonomous design platform of soft slender material systems that support large deformations and multiphysics actuation toward personalized biomedical design.
tldr: Presents a Cosserat-rod-based differentiable optimization framework for co-designing material layout and actuation of soft slender programmable structures, demonstrated on swellable stents and magnetically actuated catheters for patient-specific biomedical applications.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于Cosserat杆的可微分优化框架，用于软细长可编程结构材料的材料布局与驱动协同设计，并在可膨胀支架和磁性驱动导管等个体化生物医学应用中进行了验证。
summary_zh: 摘要：由刺激响应材料制成的细长结构代表了一类新兴的可编程材料系统，在软体机器人、微创手术、可穿戴电子设备和可展开结构等领域具有应用前景。在生物医学应用中，细长结构的按需设计（包括其材料布局和驱动方式）对于利用其大变形和多物理场驱动来满足患者特定的设计要求至关重要。然而，由于几何和材料非线性，其结构-驱动-响应关系高度非直观且计算成本高昂。这常常使得试错法和传统设计方法难以应对患者特定的需求。为此，我们提出了一种基于Cosserat杆的设计优化框架，用于可编程细长结构的自主设计。借助Cosserat杆表示，该端到端可微框架在以下两个案例研究中得到验证：(i) 可溶胀支架的设计，该支架可变形为颈动脉血管的形状；(ii) 磁活性导管的剩余磁化强度与外加磁场的协同设计，以减少插入过程中施加在患者特定血管壁上的力。同时考虑了自接触和与周围结构的外部接触。我们考虑了两种驱动机制，即凝胶-弹性体复合材料的溶胀和硬磁性复合材料的磁驱动。所提出的框架为支持大变形和多物理场驱动的软细长材料系统提供了一个自主设计平台，面向个性化生物医学设计。

title: Landmark-Free and Scale-Blind Multi-View Registration of Preoperative Liver Models to Intraoperative Surfaces
summary: Augmented-reality guidance in laparoscopic liver resection requires aligning preoperative 3D liver models from CT/MRI with intraoperative surfaces. Monocular reconstruction in most cases cannot guarantee scale, albeit rigid-motion registration requires scale as an input. Our proposed framework ``SimCompose'' estimates the full similarity transformation $\Sim$, including scale, without relying on landmarks and applies the same transformation across multiple views with known relative geometry. However, reliable detection of registration failures remains challenging in surgical settings, where ground-truth alignment is generally unavailable. For this, we propose a geometry-based selector that evaluates candidate transformations without requiring ground truth. Large disagreement among these transformations is used to flag potentially unreliable registrations. Finally, we propose to use a non-rigid refinement based on a low-dimensional deformation model from Neo-Hookean simulations in the Simulation Open Framework Architecture (SOFA), without additional network training. SimCompose is trained exclusively on synthetic partial views. Its encoder processes point clouds normalised to a unit root-mean-square radius, without access to metric scale, and filters each view before multi-view fusion. Evaluation on unseen synthetic data (300 single-view pairs per run; 100 three-view registrations) shows that multi-view integration and candidate selection increase the success rate under stringent $\Sim$ accuracy criteria from 38.4% for a single-view, single-method configuration to 77%. Existing learning-based baselines do not satisfy these criteria even when provided with the exact scale. On five in-vivo patients with 92 keyframes, the rigid registration stage reduces surface error more than three-fold relative to learning-based baselines with external scale information.
tldr: The paper proposes SimCompose, a landmark-free, scale-blind multi-view registration framework that aligns preoperative liver models to intraoperative surfaces using full similarity (Sim(3)) transformations. It includes a geometry-based candidate selector for failure detection and a SOFA-based non-rigid refinement, showing strong performance on synthetic and in-vivo data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SimCompose，一种无需标志点且尺度未知的多视角配准框架，用于将术前肝脏模型与术中表面对齐，估计完整相似变换Sim(3)，并包含基于几何的候选选择器用于失败检测，以及基于SOFA的非刚性细化模块。在合成数据和体内数据上均表现出较强性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：

腹腔镜肝切除术中的增强现实引导需要将来自CT/MRI的术前3D肝脏模型与术中表面进行对齐。在大多数情况下，单目重建无法保证尺度，尽管刚体运动配准需要将尺度作为输入。我们提出的框架“SimCompose”估计完整的相似变换$\Sim$（包括尺度），且不依赖 landmarks，并将同一变换应用于具有已知相对几何关系的多个视图。然而，在手术场景中，可靠的配准失败检测仍然具有挑战性，因为真实对齐通常不可用。为此，我们提出了一种基于几何的选择器，无需真实值即可评估候选变换。这些变换之间的大幅度不一致被用于标记可能不可靠的配准。最后，我们提出使用基于Simulation Open Framework Architecture (SOFA)中Neo-Hookean仿真的低维形变模型进行非刚体细化，无需额外网络训练。SimCompose仅在合成部分视图上训练。其编码器处理归一化到单位均方根半径的点云，无需访问度量尺度，并在多视图融合之前对每个视图进行过滤。在未见过的合成数据上的评估（每次运行300对单视图；100次三视图配准）表明，在严格的$\Sim$精度标准下，多视图集成和候选选择将成功率从单视图、单方法配置的38.4%提高到77%。现有的基于学习的基线方法即使在提供精确尺度的情况下也无法满足这些标准。在五名体内患者共92个关键帧上，刚体配准阶段相对于具有外部尺度信息的基于学习基线，将表面误差降低三倍以上。

title: EGIP: An Evidence-Grounded Interaction Protocol for Clinical Agents
summary: Interactive clinical agents acquire evidence through patient dialogue and diagnostic examinations, yet their performance also depends on how the interaction environment exposes information, available actions, and examination results. When these conditions are implicit or inconsistently controlled, final-answer accuracy can conflate diagnostic reasoning with the effects of the interaction protocol. We propose the \textbf{E}vidence-\textbf{G}rounded \textbf{I}nteraction \textbf{P}rotocol (EGIP), which enforces role-specific information boundaries, exposes diagnostic actions without revealing their results, retrieves examination results from stored clinical records, and organizes acquired evidence for final decision-making. By separating evidence acquisition from terminal prediction, EGIP enables different decision strategies to operate on the same observations. We evaluate EGIP across two clinical-agent frameworks, five datasets, and six language models. EGIP improves diagnostic accuracy over native baselines across all primary comparisons. A clinician review further shows that the proportion of automatically scored correct responses jointly judged evidence-supported rises from 10.20\% to 36.55\%. These findings support the effectiveness of EGIP as a unified interaction protocol for improving clinical-agent performance through controlled evidence access and acquisition.
tldr: Proposes EGIP, a protocol for clinical agents that controls evidence gathering through role-specific information boundaries, hidden diagnostic action results, retrieval from stored records, and organized evidence, improving diagnostic accuracy across multiple frameworks, datasets, and language models.
tldr_zh: 提出EGIP，一种面向临床智能体的交互协议，通过角色信息边界、不预先暴露检查结果、从临床记录检索以及组织证据来规范证据采集过程，从而在多个框架、数据集和语言模型上提升诊断准确率。
summary_zh: 交互式临床智能体通过患者对话和诊断检查获取证据，但其性能也取决于交互环境如何暴露信息、可用动作和检查结果。当这些条件隐式存在或控制不一致时，最终答案的准确率可能会将诊断推理与交互协议的影响混为一谈。我们提出了**证据 grounded 交互协议（EGIP）**，它强制实施角色特定的信息边界，在不揭示结果的情况下暴露诊断动作，从存储的临床记录中检索检查结果，并组织已获取的证据用于最终决策。通过将证据获取与终局预测分离，EGIP使得不同决策策略能够在相同的观测上运行。我们在两个临床智能体框架、五个数据集和六个语言模型上评估了EGIP。在所有主要对比中，EGIP相较于原生基线提高了诊断准确率。临床医生审查进一步表明，自动评分正确且被共同判定为有证据支持的响应比例从10.20\%上升到36.55\%。这些发现支持EGIP作为一种统一交互协议的有效性，通过受控的证据访问和获取来提升临床智能体性能。

title: TCMScience: An Autonomous Scientist for Traditional Chinese Medicine
summary: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research connects classical texts, medicinal entities, molecular assays, computational predictions, and clinical studies. An autonomous research agent must preserve the inferential boundaries between these evidence types while coordinating analysis across heterogeneous resources. We introduce TCMScience, a scientific knowledge-discovery agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority. Its architecture combines a trusted kernel, a scientific compiler, and claim-support contracts: plans are compiled into typed operations, execution is bounded by explicit permissions, and candidate findings are checked against source provenance, study design, and claim scope before release. The full capability registry contains 117 public-source connectors with 444 typed operations across 29 domains and 150 native tools across 12 domains; the TCM data hub catalogs 136 databases, 76 dataset specifications, and 84,294 formula-source records. These resources support model-independent workflows through browser and local execution interfaces. In a network-pharmacology analysis of Gegen Qinlian Tang, replacing the whole-proteome background with the assayed-protein background changed the number of significant pathways from 66 to zero; incorporating inactive screening records identified nine pathways, including drug-metabolism signals retained as mechanistic hypotheses. A governance ablation over 121 constructed erroneous outputs spanning 26 classes released 121 errors without governance, 57 with the domain layer, seven with the kernel, and zero with both layers. All 10 compliant controls were retained. These results establish complementary control of known failure modes and show how explicit evidence contracts change the conclusions an agent is permitted to report.
tldr: TCMScience is a governance-aware scientific discovery agent for traditional Chinese medicine that compiles language-model proposals into typed, permission-bound operations and checks candidate findings against provenance and study-design contracts before release; evaluations show layered governance blocks erroneous outputs while preserving compliant results.
tldr_zh: TCMScience 是一个面向中医药的治理感知科学发现智能体，它将语言模型提案编译为带类型与权限约束的操作，并在发布前依据来源和实验设计合约检查候选发现；实验表明分层治理能阻止错误输出，同时保留合规结果。
summary_zh: 中医药（TCM）研究将经典文献、药物实体、分子实验、计算预测和临床研究联系起来。自主研究智能体必须在协调跨异构资源分析的同时，保持这些证据类型之间的推理边界。我们介绍了TCMScience，一个科学知识发现智能体，它将语言模型的提议与执行和发布权限分离。其架构结合了可信内核、科学编译器和主张支持契约：计划被编译为类型化操作，执行受显式权限约束，候选发现在发布前根据来源溯源、研究设计和主张范围进行检查。完整能力注册表包含117个公共来源连接器，涵盖29个领域的444种类型化操作，以及12个领域的150个原生工具；TCM数据中心编录了136个数据库、76个数据集规范以及84,294条方剂来源记录。这些资源通过浏览器和本地执行接口支持与模型无关的工作流程。在对葛根芩连汤的网络药理学分析中，将全蛋白质组背景替换为已测定蛋白质背景后，显著通路的数量从66条变为0条；纳入非活性筛选记录后识别出9条通路，其中包括保留为机制假说的药物代谢信号。对涵盖26个类别的121个构造错误输出进行的治理消融实验显示，无治理时放行了121个错误，有领域层时放行57个，有内核时放行7个，两层都有时放行0个。所有10个合规对照均被保留。这些结果确立了对已知失败模式的互补控制，并展示了显式证据契约如何改变智能体被允许报告的结论。

title: Trust the Edge, Doubt the Arrow: Auditing Validation Signals for Text-Mined Clinical Causal Knowledge Graphs
summary: Clinical causal retrieval-augmented generation systems increasingly use knowledge graphs (KGs) mined from notes, yet extracted assertions remain candidates that require audit for patient-level EHR support and direction. We construct a directed candidate graph from 328,839 MIMIC-IV discharge summaries using LLM extraction and UMLS normalization, and evaluate three signals against SemMedDB: within-admission co-occurrence lift, cross-admission diagnosis-coding temporal precedence, and literature corroboration. Lift filters unsupported co-mentions and provides useful EHR support, but not causal proof. Coding order is a weak direction signal: among the 686 candidates where it commits, it reaches 54.2% agreement with SemMedDB, below the extractor's 69.4% on the same subset. Literature corroboration supplies independent direction evidence but covers only 30.4% of candidate relations. A MIMIC-III replication yields the same pattern: extractor direction remains stable (70.5%), whereas coding-order direction is near chance (50.9%). Thus, text-mined clinical causal candidate KGs are best treated as EHR-supported but direction-uncertain. In a leakage-controlled causal QA benchmark, lift-only retrieval achieves 35.7% accuracy; conservative causal demotion achieves 37.2% while reducing evidence-unsupported answers from 17.3% to 6.1% at fixed retrieval recall. We release code, aggregate summaries, and scripts to regenerate restricted outputs.
tldr: This paper audits validation signals for text-mined clinical causal knowledge graphs, showing that co-occurrence lift provides EHR support but not causal direction, while diagnosis-coding temporal precedence is near chance as a direction signal. A conservative causal demotion strategy reduces evidence-unsupported answers in a causal QA benchmark.
tldr_zh: 该论文评估了从临床文本挖掘的因果知识图谱的验证信号，发现共现提升可提供EHR支持但无法证明因果方向，诊断编码时序作为方向信号接近随机。提出的保守因果降级策略在因果问答基准中减少了缺乏证据支持的答案。
summary_zh:
摘要：
临床因果检索增强生成系统越来越多地使用从病历中挖掘的知识图谱（KGs），但提取出的断言仍然是候选，需要审计以确定其对患者级电子健康记录（EHR）的支持程度和方向。我们使用LLM提取和UMLS标准化，从328，839份MIMIC-IV出院小结中构建了一个有向候选图，并针对SemMedDB评估了三种信号：入院内共现提升度、跨入院诊断编码时间优先性以及文献佐证。提升度能过滤无支持的同现提及，并提供有用的EHR支持，但并不构成因果证明。编码顺序是一个较弱的方向信号：在它做出判断的686个候选中，与SemMedDB的一致性为54.2%，低于提取器在同一子集上的69.4%。文献佐证提供了独立的方向证据，但仅覆盖30.4%的候选关系。MIMIC-III重复实验得出相同模式：提取器方向保持稳定（70.5%），而编码顺序方向接近随机水平（50.9%）。因此，从文本中挖掘的临床因果候选知识图谱最适合视为获得EHR支持但方向不确定。在泄漏控制的因果问答基准中，仅使用提升度检索的准确率为35.7%；保守的因果降权方法达到37.2%，同时在固定检索召回率下将无证据支持的答案从17.3%降至6.1%。我们发布了代码、汇总摘要以及用于重新生成受限输出的脚本。

title: Screening LLM Judges Without Ground Truth: A Preliminary Evaluation of an AI Dental Hygiene Coach
summary: Evaluating a fine-tuned coaching model with expert graders is slow and expensive, and an LLM judge cannot be trusted without ground truth. We present a staged pipeline that screens candidate LLM judges and student models before expert review, using explicit decision rules at each stage: judge output audit, similarity with hosted judges, bias checks, and decision robustness. We demonstrate it on an AI dental hygiene coach. The case study uses synthetic, clinically unvalidated training and reference data to demonstrate the operation of the pipeline, rather than to establish the clinical performance of the resulting models. Two fine-tuned small language models (Granite-4.1-8B and Qwen3-8B), each trained at three data sizes, were scored on seven metrics by five judges (three local, two hosted). Two local judges, Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-31B-it, were not distinguishable from the agreement between the hosted judges on six of seven metrics by rank correlation, and Qwen3.8-27B was the most similar to the hosted judges overall. No judge met our criterion for favoring its own model family or training-data source. The student comparison did not separate the two models on any metric under the pipeline's rule, so the choice of Granite-4.1-8B, which led in 29 of 35 judge-by-metric cells, is a lean that depends partly on truncated Qwen3-8B outputs. The pipeline also surfaced problems that raw scores hid, including the truncated outputs and hallucination flags from one hosted judge that no other judge corroborated. No dental hygiene expert has graded these responses, so the findings are preliminary and the pipeline's final stage, anchoring to expert judgement, is proposed but not performed.
tldr: Proposes a staged pipeline to screen LLM judges and student models without ground truth, using explicit decision rules, bias checks, and robustness analysis, demonstrated on an AI dental hygiene coach with synthetic data and no expert validation.
tldr_zh: 提出一种在没有真值标签的情况下筛选LLM评审器和学生模型的分阶段流程，通过显式决策规则、偏差检验和稳健性分析，在AI牙科卫生教练案例上进行初步演示；目前使用合成数据，尚未经过专家验证。
summary_zh: 评估一个经过微调的教练模型需要专家评分者，过程缓慢且成本高昂，而缺乏基准真值时，LLM评审也不足为信。我们提出了一种分阶段流水线，在专家评审之前，通过每个阶段明确的决策规则来筛选候选LLM评审和学生模型，这些规则包括：评审输出审计、与托管评审的相似性、偏差检查以及决策稳健性。我们将其应用于一个AI口腔卫生教练案例。该案例研究使用合成且未经临床验证的训练数据和参考数据来演示流水线的运作，而非确立所得模型的临床性能。两个微调的小语言模型（Granite-4.1-8B 和 Qwen3-8B），各自在三种数据规模下训练，由五位评审（三位本地，两位托管）在七项指标上进行评分。在七项指标中的六项上，本地评审Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma-4-31B-it与托管评审之间的一致性，在秩相关上与托管评审彼此之间的一致性无法区分；总体而言，Qwen3.8-27B与托管评审最为相似。没有任何评审满足我们关于偏袒自身模型家族或训练数据来源的判定标准。根据流水线的规则，学生模型比较未能在任何指标上将两个模型区分开，因此选择Granite-4.1-8B（在35个“评审×指标”单元中的29个中领先）是一种倾向性选择，部分依赖于被截断的Qwen3-8B输出。流水线还揭示了原始分数所隐藏的问题，包括被截断的输出，以及来自某位托管评审的幻觉标记（无其他评审佐证）。目前尚无口腔卫生专家对这些回答进行评分，因此研究结果是初步的；流水线的最后阶段——以专家判断为锚定——已提出但尚未执行。
